headlines.title: Ground stop lifted: Bay Area airports impacted, what happens next?
headlines.description: The whale that stranded alive at Cowell Beach in Santa Cruz on Thursday morning and later died had been ill for a long time, according to authorities. The Long Marine Lab Stranding Network said it conducted a necropsy on Saturday morning on the fin whale, and researchers found the whale was a 55-foot female weighing more than 58,000 pounds and was “very emaciated, potentially indicating she had been ill for weeks or months”. The necropsy was conducted with partners from the California Academy of Sciences and the Marine Mammal Center at the Dimeo Lane Resource Recovery Facility, the Long Marine Lab Stranding Network said. Officials said extensive samples were collected and will be processed over the coming weeks to determine a definitive cause of death. The additional findings are expected to be released over the next month.
headlines.source: Josh Funk and Will Weissert | Associated Press, Jodi Hernandez, Damian Trujillo, Sergio Quintana, Kristofer Noceda and Victoria Meza
